nodes.description: Mapping of address to token balance, written by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount written by approve/approveAndCall and read by allowance.
Public total token supply, initialised in the IdeaCoin constructor.
Public token name string.
Public token decimals value.
Public token symbol string.
Public version string of the token contract.
Public rate variable, never set in this code.
Public accumulator of ether received, never set in this code.
Public address receiving funds, set to msg.sender in the constructor.
Abstract ERC20 interface function totalSupply().
Abstract ERC20 interface function balanceOf(address).
Abstract ERC20 interface function transfer(address,uint256).
Abstract ERC20 interface function transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
Abstract ERC20 interface function approve(address,uint256).
Abstract ERC20 interface function allowance(address,address).
ERC20 transfer implementation; debits msg.sender and credits _to with overflow guard.
ERC20 transferFrom implementation; moves balances and decrements the allowance of msg.sender.
Returns the balance stored in the balances mapping for _owner.
Sets the allowance of _spender for msg.sender in the allowed mapping.
Returns the remaining allowance from the allowed mapping.
Constructor issuing the whole supply to msg.sender and setting token metadata and fundsWallet.
Approves _spender and then performs an unchecked external low-level call to it.
Caller address used as the owner key when mutating balances in transfer.
Caller address used as spender key in the allowed mapping during transferFrom.
Caller address used as owner key when writing the allowed mapping in approve.
Deployer address receiving the initial supply and becoming fundsWallet.
Caller address used as owner key and forwarded to the external callee in approveAndCall.
Subtraction of _value from balances[msg.sender] (unchecked prior to 0.8 arithmetic).
Addition of _value to balances[_to] guarded only by a manual overflow comparison.
Addition of _value to balances[_to] inside transferFrom.
Subtraction of _value from balances[_from] inside transferFrom.
Subtraction of _value from the caller allowance inside transferFrom.
External low-level call to _spender with no gas limit and a throw-on-failure check, enabling reentrancy.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Spender/callee address parameter of approveAndCall.
Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall.
Arbitrary bytes forwarded to the external callee.

edges.reason: StandardToken.transfer executes the balance subtraction on msg.sender.
StandardToken.transfer executes the balance addition to _to.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping in the subtraction.
_to is the mapping key of the balance increase.
_value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender].
_value is added to balances[_to].
transferFrom executes the recipient balance increase.
transferFrom executes the source balance decrease.
transferFrom executes the allowance decrease.
_from indexes the balances mapping in the subtraction.
_value is subtracted from balances[_from].
_to is the key of the recipient balance increase.
_value is added to balances[_to].
msg.sender indexes the nested allowance mapping.
_value is subtracted from the caller allowance.
_spender is the key written in the allowed mapping.
_value is stored in the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowed mapping in approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
_spender is the target of the low-level call.
_value is forwarded as an argument to the callee.
_extraData is forwarded as an argument to the callee.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowed mapping in approveAndCall.
msg.sender is passed as an argument to the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external low-level call to an untrusted address.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to is only used as the key of the balances[_to] assignment, so it normalises into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _value is only used as the operand of balances[msg.sender] -= _value, so it normalises into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _from is only used as the key of balances[_from] -= _value, so it normalises into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _to is only used as the key of balances[_to] += _value, so it normalises into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _value drives all balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom and normalises into the source-balance decrement.
Parameter _spender only indexes the allowed mapping written inside StandardToken.approve, so it normalises into that function.
Parameter _value is only stored in the allowed mapping by StandardToken.approve, so it normalises into that function.
Parameter _spender is the direct target of the low-level call, so it normalises into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _value is forwarded to the callee through the low-level call, so it normalises into that unsafe operation.
Parameter _extraData is forwarded verbatim to the callee through the low-level call, so it normalises into that unsafe operation.
